summary: Denmark (DK) localization of Business Central 29. It covers OIOUBL electronic invoicing and NemHandel, electronic VAT return submission to the Danish Tax Agency, FIK payment matching, digital vouchers, Payroll data import and C5 data migration. Use it for questions on Danish e-invoicing, VAT, bank and bookkeeping-act requirements.
overview:
The Danish layer is almost entirely new objects (408, none changing W1 objects directly). The largest parts are OIOUBL: table and page extensions on sales, reminder, finance charge memo and service documents, check codeunits and export codeunits that produce OIOUBL XML. NemHandel status codeunits and E-Document handlers (OIOUBL format and import into draft) link this to the E-Documents flow.

Finance holds the electronic VAT declaration (setup page, communication logs, SKAT API, Azure Key Vault, period, submit and validate codeunits behind three interfaces) and ECSL export. Bank holds FIK management and matching for payment reconciliation and general journals, plus fixed-width payment export. Digital voucher support, Proløn payroll import and the C5 migration tool (codeunits, pages and xmlports) complete the layer.

Microsoft Learn documents bookkeeping act compliance, digital vouchers, five-year retention, SAF-T and Regnskab Basis export, standard chart of accounts, OIOUBL setup, NemHandel, FIK details, VAT reconciliation, VAT-VIES, Intrastat and payroll definitions.
key_points: OIOUBL electronic invoices, credit memos, reminders and finance charge memos for sales and service, with check and export codeunits and customer fields such as GLN and account code.
NemHandel support: registration status checks, notification on Company Information, and OIOUBL format in E-Documents.
Electronic VAT declaration submitted through the Danish Tax Agency VAT API, with certificates, Azure Key Vault and communication logs.
FIK payment matching in payment reconciliation and general journals, plus payment file export.
Digital vouchers and five-year data retention support the Danish bookkeeping act.
Proløn payroll data import through data exchange definitions.
C5 data migration wizard imports customers, vendors, items and ledger data.
SAF-T and Regnskab Basis export use the Audit File Export app with standard chart of accounts mapping.

areas.what: Adds a C5 data migration tool: install, schema reader, unzip and data loader codeunits, migrators for customers, vendors, items and ledger accounts and transactions, and many C5 staging tables, pages and xmlports.
Implements OIOUBL document checks, XML export and posting subscribers for sales, service, reminders and finance charge memos. Adds NemHandel status checks and digital voucher implementation.
areas.why: Danish public sector requires invoices in OIOUBL format, and NemHandel registration status is notified to companies.

areas.what: Adds electronic VAT declaration with setup, period retrieval, XML building, signing, submission and logs through interfaces, plus ECSL export, VAT report setup and Danish install and upgrade codeunits.
areas.why: Danish companies submit VAT returns electronically through the Danish Tax Agency VAT API.

areas.what: Adds FIK payment handling: management, matching of bank reconciliation and general journal lines, file reading, fixed-width payment export and fields on vendors, purchase headers and ledger entries.
areas.why: FIK payments applied automatically produce transaction texts such as matching, partial or excess amounts in the payment reconciliation journal.

areas.what: Table and page extensions add OIOUBL fields to customers, sales invoices and credit memos, reminders, finance charge memos, orders and receivables setup.
areas.why: OIOUBL requires data such as GLN, account code and profile code on customers and documents.

areas.what: Table and page extensions add OIOUBL fields to service orders, invoices, credit memos, archives and service management setup.
Extends payment terms, country/region and company information with OIOUBL fields.
areas.why: OIOUBL setup requires payment terms and company information to be configured.

areas.what: Connects OIOUBL to the E-Documents framework with an OIOUBL format, import into draft and a handler.
areas.why: NemHandel e-invoicing uses OIOUBL or PEPPOL BIS 3.0 through the E-Documents connector.

areas.what: Adds import of payroll transactions from Danish providers with a Proløn xmlport, data exchange definition import, setup page and general journal extension.
areas.why: The Payroll Data Definitions extension maps provider transaction types to general ledger accounts.

areas.what: Holds the C5 Data Loader Status table used by the C5 migration.
Adds a Danish event subscriber for the expense agent.
Extends item charges with OIOUBL fields.
Extends the record export buffer with OIOUBL data for file export.

issues: Small point: the overview says the C5 migration tool includes xmlports. The input has 35 xmlports and shows only one by name, the Proløn import (xmlport 13600). That the rest belong to C5 is a reasonable inference from the 121-object DataMigration area, but the input does not list them.

Small point: the key points leave out VAT reconciliation reports, VAT-VIES / EC Sales List and the Intrastat VAT registration number format. These are only mentioned in the overview, which is acceptable.
